issues.description: Override semantics silently changed; overrideCount doubled from 6 to 12 against a test named 'do not run on references'.
issues.detail: The previous `if (!seen.isParent) ctx.override(...)` guard was removed, so override now fires for every seen entry. The test was updated to 12 without explanation, contradicting its own name. Either restore the guard or explicitly document the new contract in code and changelog before merge.

issues.description: JSON.stringify used as structural equality in nested key loops is quadratic and key-order-fragile.
issues.detail: Two `for (const key in schema)` passes call `JSON.stringify(schema[key]) === JSON.stringify(refSeen.def![key])` per key. This is O(N*size) on deep schemas and produces false negatives when key insertion order differs. Extract a named structural-equality helper or compare by reference/fingerprint computed once.

issues.description: play.ts scratchpad with debug console.logs and relative source import should not ship.
issues.detail: The diff repoints play.ts at `./packages/zod/src/index.js` and adds console.log debugging cases. This is local author scratch coupling a top-level file to internal source layout. Revert play.ts or convert the two cases into named tests under `tests/`.

issues.description: flattenRef recursion on seen.parent lacks an independent guard, risking re-entry or stack overflow.
issues.detail: Only `seen.ref` is nulled as a sentinel, but flattenRef also recurses on `seen.parent` with no equivalent guard. If parent chains ever form a cycle the recursion does not terminate. Add an explicit visited set or document why parent chains are guaranteed acyclic.

issues.description: Two-field contract distinguishing Seen.ref from Seen.parent is not written down.
issues.detail: `ref` (processor-set inheritance source) and `parent` (clone-chain ancestor) now overlap with the rule `if (!result.ref) result.ref = parent`. Their invariants, divergence conditions, and guarantees to flattenRef are nowhere stated. Add a docblock on the Seen interface so maintainers do not re-conflate them.

issues.description: Commit bundles three independent changes; should be split.
issues.detail: The diff reworks parent/ref tracking, changes fileProcessor anyOf hoisting (a user-visible JSON Schema output change), and flips mini ZodType to pass `{parent: true}`. Each is independently reviewable and revertable. Split into three patches so each can be evaluated and rolled back on its own.

synthesis.summary: The panel converges on NEEDS-WORK. The underlying refactor — separating processor-set `ref` from clone-chain `parent` so $ref propagation survives wrappers — is sound and fixes a real bug, but the patch ships in the wrong shape. Three P0s block landing: a silent override-contract change that doubles invocations against a test literally named "do not run on references", quadratic JSON.stringify-based dedup loops, and a debug scratchpad in play.ts. Beyond those, flattenRef's parent recursion lacks a termination guard, the new two-field Seen contract is undocumented, and the commit bundles three independent changes that should be split.
